screenshotReadiness.interpretation: Similar upstream reported symptom, not proven identical to Linux1.63 defect. Offscreen image requests remained pending; exact upstream root cause not established.
screenshotReadiness.application: Only release verification process uses PW_TEST_SCREENSHOT_NO_FONTS_READY=1; runtime code unchanged. Use DOMContentLoaded plus explicit UI/functional checks. Font loading not claimed verified on physical iOS.

hydration.finding: Visible SSR controls can be clicked before listeners attach. Official guidance recommends withholding interaction until hydration.
hydration.application: ServiceShell main uses inert until its mount effect completes. React18 string attribute follows the existing StudioShell pattern. Delayed application scripts reproduce old keyboard-focus failure on settings/feed; final image8 cases pass.

initialFailuresAndResolution: First production UI run exposed early clicks before hydration. Reproduced with delayed scripts on old image: settings and feed failures. ServiceShell now keeps main inert until mounted; final image and production8 delayed-script cases verify keyboard/pointer gating and subsequent action. React18 inert string typing was aligned with existing StudioShell after first type/build failure.
Workspace old OptionalImage test mock caused two failures; use existing real helper and assert membership-only image. Final workspace321 passed.
Selected runtime excludes unrelated deferred-signup test, which expects an undeployed local contract. Exclusion is explicit and does not change production signup.
Production-build draft preview used different server/browser time zones. Reproduced React425/422; explicit Asia/Seoul fixes UTC/Seoul/LA unit and4JS-off/on browser conditions.

WebKit forced full-document navigation aborted prefetch requests. Service detail entries now use separate documents; navigation inventory separately records same-origin access-control messages only during harness goto. No React/app errors discarded.

WebKit load/font-ready waits stalled despite interactive UI and zero font faces. Official similar issues reviewed. Explicit UI readiness and process-only screenshot font wait bypass used; original failures preserved. Exact upstream root cause and physical iOS behavior not claimed.
